mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gauges ( project_id, yarn_name, needle_size, stitch_count, row_count, measured_width_cm, measured_height_cm, is_selected, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{yarnName}, #{needleSize}, #{stitchCount}, #{rowCount}, #{measuredWidthCm}, #{measuredHeightCm}, #{isSelected}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT gauge_id AS gaugeId, project_id AS projectId, yarn_name AS yarnName, needle_size AS needleSize, stitch_count AS stitchCount, row_count AS rowCount, measured_width_cm AS measuredWidthCm, measured_height_cm AS measuredHeightCm, is_selected AS isSelected, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM gauges
WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
ORDER BY created_at ASC
